name: agentmemory
description: Local-first project continuity with explicit checkpoints and reviewed memory.

interface.shortDescription: Project checkpoints, reviewed memory, and bounded session resume.
interface.longDescription: AgentMemory stores project-scoped checkpoints and review-gated memory, then injects a bounded read-only resume capsule at SessionStart.
defaultPrompt: Use $agentmemory to inspect this project's continuity status.
Use $agentmemory to create an explicit project checkpoint.
Use $agentmemory to review a candidate only after I confirm.
